en_title: Tom Holland Reveals How He Brought Finishing Moves From Sony's Spider-Man Games to Brand New Day
cn_title: 霍兰德将索尼《蜘蛛侠》终结技搬进《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》
subtitle: 从手柄到银幕
opus_summary: 汤姆·霍兰德与导演Destin Daniel Cretton透露，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的动作借鉴索尼游戏，并把终结技和Peter Parker的招式带上银幕。影片7月31日上映。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Tom Holland and director Destin Daniel Cretton opened up about taking inspiration from Sony’s Spider-Man games and how they translated elements of their combat into the newest Spidey movie.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的主演汤姆·霍兰德与导演Destin Daniel Cretton谈到，他们如何从索尼《蜘蛛侠》游戏中汲取灵感，把其中的战斗元素融入最新一部蜘蛛侠电影。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Jeffrey Vega got the chance to speak with Holland on the red carpet at Brand New Day’s premier on Monday, July 27, where he asked what exactly about the games inspired his creative process for the film.
paragraphs.cn: 在周一（7月27日）《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的首映红毯上，IGN的Jeffrey Vega采访了霍兰德，问他游戏的哪些部分启发了自己为影片进行的创作。

paragraphs.en: For Holland, it was all about the finishing moves, which are special flourishes that let Spidey take down enemies with style. Having played the games, he wanted to incorporate these into the film — and he wasn’t the only one on set itching to do it, either.
paragraphs.cn: 对霍兰德而言，关键在于终结技：这是让蜘蛛侠以华丽方式击败敌人的特殊招式。他玩过这些游戏，想把它们融入电影；而他并不是片场唯一跃跃欲试的人。

paragraphs.en: “A lot of the action,” inspired him, he told us. “A lot of the finishing moves. I was actually playing the game last night. I couldn’t sleep last night, I was so excited about today. I was trying to figure out what I was gonna do, and I was like, ‘I’ll just throw the game on and have some fun.’
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉我们，启发他的「是大量的动作，还有大量的终结技。我昨晚其实还在玩游戏。因为太期待今天了，昨晚睡不着，一直在想该做什么，后来心想：‘干脆打开游戏玩玩吧。’」

paragraphs.en: “For me, a lot of those finishing moves, a lot of our stuff was influenced by that stuff.”
paragraphs.cn: 「对我来说，很多终结技，还有我们的许多动作，都是受那些东西影响的。」

paragraphs.en: Additionally, Destin Daniel Cretton revealed that many of the stunt performers on Brand New Day were fans of the Spider-Man games, even bringing screenshots of Peter Parker’s moves into the writers’ room to see what they could bring from the digital world into the real one.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，Destin Daniel Cretton透露，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的许多特技表演者都是《蜘蛛侠》游戏的粉丝。他们甚至会把Peter Parker招式的截图带进编剧室，看看能把数字世界里的哪些东西搬到现实中。

paragraphs.en: “A lot of the action designers and stunt people we had were huge gamers,” he explained. “They were able to experience things in those games that made them excited, and they would just screengrab the moves they really liked and bring them into the writers’ room and show it to me. And then we’d be like, ‘Yeah, that’s sick. Let’s try to figure out how to do that for real.’”
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「我们有很多动作设计师和特技人员都是重度玩家。他们能在那些游戏里体验到让自己兴奋的内容，于是会截下自己特别喜欢的招式，带到编剧室给我看。然后我们就会说：‘对，这太酷了。我们来想想怎么把它在现实中做出来。’」

paragraphs.en: This isn't the first time Holland has spoken out about his love for Insomniac's Spider-Man games; back in June, he told IGN Benelux that both he and wife Zendaya are big fans, though Zendaya joked that she wouldn't let her hubby help her out on more difficult parts and bossfights as she wanted to experience it all on her own.
paragraphs.cn: 这并非霍兰德第一次谈到自己喜爱Insomniac的《蜘蛛侠》游戏：今年6月他曾对IGN Benelux表示，他和妻子Zendaya都是忠实粉丝。不过Zendaya开玩笑说，她不会让老公帮自己打较难的关卡和Boss战，因为想亲自体验全部内容。

paragraphs.en: Speaking of the Spider-Man games, Sony itself is celebrating Brand New Day in style, adding Tom Holland’s suit from the movie into Spider-Man 2 in honor of the occasion. That’s not all; players will also get a second suit inspired by Peter Parker’s look in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, Sony's second collaboration with the fighting game after Marvel’s Wolverine was also confirmed to get a Tokon-inspired suit and vice versa.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到《蜘蛛侠》游戏，索尼也在隆重庆祝《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》：为纪念影片上映，索尼会把汤姆·霍兰德在片中的战衣加入《蜘蛛侠2》。这还不止；玩家还会获得第二套战衣，灵感来自Peter Parker在《Marvel Tokon：Fighting Souls》中的造型。后者是索尼继《漫威金刚狼》后第二次与这款格斗游戏合作；《漫威金刚狼》也已确认会加入一套受Tokon启发的战衣，Tokon这边则反过来加入受《漫威金刚狼》启发的战衣。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day hits theaters on Friday, July 31. The fourth Spidey movie is already projected to have one of the biggest opening weekends of 2026, with Deadline estimating it’ll rake in at least $180 - $190 million at the domestic box office, while Box Office Pro predicts a substantially more optimistic $230 – $250 million.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》将于周五（7月31日）上映。这部第四部蜘蛛侠电影预计将迎来2026年规模最大的首周末之一：Deadline估计其北美票房至少可达1.8亿美元(约合人民币12亿元)至1.9亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)，而Box Office Pro的预测更乐观，大幅上调至2.3亿美元(约合人民币16亿元)至2.5亿美元(约合人民币17亿元)。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Tom Jorgensen gave the movie a 7 out of 10 , saying it “effectively refocuses on the most reliable pillars of the webslinger: swinging around NYC saving the day and looking cool while doing so," while admitting that, at points, "Peter’s inner turmoil ...sometimes leaves the 'brand new day' of the title feeling like Groundhog Day."
paragraphs.cn: IGN的Tom Jorgensen给影片打了7/10分，称它「有效地重新聚焦于蜘蛛侠最可靠的核心要素：在纽约市荡着蛛丝拯救世界，并在此过程中耍酷」，但也承认，有些时候「Peter内心的挣扎……会让片名所说的‘崭新之日’有时像《土拨鼠之日》一样周而复始」。
